title: ApprovalRequest
description: Human-in-the-loop approval envelope for simulation-gated deployments. Every infrastructure fix generated by the analytical brain must pass through: (1) static blocklist scan, (2) E2B micro-sandbox validation, (3) git worktree isolation, and (4) this approval gate before any production write. This schema carries the full audit chain.

approval_id.description: Unique identifier for this approval request.

incident_id.description: Reference to the incident that triggered this fix. Links to the bi-temporal graph node.

fix_script.description: The proposed infrastructure fix. Content has been static-scanned for blocked patterns before sandbox execution.

sandbox_result.description: Execution result from the E2B micro-sandbox. Only sandbox_result.status='pass' allows the approval request to proceed.

worktree_branch.description: Git branch name in the isolated worktree zone (YYLO pattern). Format: 'fix/<incident_id_short>/<descriptive_slug>'.

diff_summary.description: Human-readable unified diff of the proposed changes. Rendered in the Slack approval block for review.

post_mortem_md.description: RunLore-style automated markdown post-mortem. Includes timeline, root cause analysis, resolution steps, and impact assessment.

requested_by.description: What triggered this approval request. 'state_machine' = FSM reached APPROVE state. 'manual_escalation' = human operator requested re-review.

requested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the approval request was created.

decision.description: Current approval state. 'expired' if no decision within the configured TTL.

decided_by.description: Identifier of the human who approved or rejected (e.g., Slack user ID). Null while decision=pending.

decided_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the approval/rejection decision.

decision_reason.description: Optional human-provided reason for rejection. Stored for audit and post-mortem analysis.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds before the approval request expires. Default: 1 hour.

slack_channel.description: Slack channel ID where the approval Block Kit message was posted.

slack_message_ts.description: Slack message timestamp for updating the approval block after a decision.

risk_level.description: Computed risk assessment of the proposed fix. Based on: blast radius, service tier, change type, and time-of-day.

blast_radius.description: Impact assessment of the proposed change.

FixScript.description: A proposed infrastructure fix script. Must pass static blocklist scan before E2B sandbox execution.

language.description: Script language/format. Determines which parser and blocklist rules to apply.

content.description: The script content. Must NOT contain unmasked infrastructure identifiers.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of content. Verified before sandbox execution and again before deployment to detect tampering.

blocked_patterns_scanned.description: Whether the static blocklist scanner has verified this script is free of destructive patterns (rm -rf, force-delete, DROP TABLE, etc.). Must be true before sandbox execution.

blocked_patterns_found.description: List of blocked patterns found during scanning. If non-empty, sandbox execution is forbidden.

generated_by_state.description: FSM state that generated this script (for audit trail).

SandboxResult.description: Result of executing the fix script inside an E2B ephemeral micro-sandbox. The sandbox has no production network access.

sandbox_id.description: E2B sandbox instance identifier. Used for log retrieval and audit.

status.description: Validation outcome. Only 'pass' allows the approval gate to open.

exit_code.description: Process exit code from the sandbox execution. 0 = success.

stdout.description: Captured standard output from sandbox execution. Truncated if exceeding maxLength.

stderr.description: Captured standard error from sandbox execution. Truncated if exceeding maxLength.

duration_ms.description: Sandbox execution wall-clock time in milliseconds.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when sandbox execution began.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when sandbox execution completed.

resource_usage.description: Resource consumption metrics from the sandbox.

BlastRadius.description: Impact assessment for the proposed infrastructure change.

affected_services.description: List of service names impacted by this change (masked identifiers).

service_tier.description: Highest service tier affected. tier0 = mission-critical, requires additional approval.

estimated_downtime_seconds.description: Estimated downtime in seconds if the fix is applied.

ResourceUsage.description: Resource consumption metrics from the E2B sandbox execution.

network_egress_bytes.description: Network bytes sent. Should be 0 for properly isolated sandboxes.
